title: Implement catalog_preview_cache component
description:
Implement catalog_preview_cache.py for project catalog-api using the component API in README.md.

The component must export:
- POLICY: the complete approved nested policy (preserving JSON keys and types)
- SOURCE and RATIONALE: the exact named approval fields
- create_cache(clock): returns a working ResponseCache governed by that policy

The approved response-cache agreement to apply is stored at memory key catalog-api.response-cache (current v2, Operations approval CACHE-18 (2026-09-06)). Recall that key to obtain the full policy before implementing. This is the current standing agreement; do not use catalog-api.response-cache.v1 (the historical v1 snapshot, kept for audit replay only).

Add component tests covering policy field values, SOURCE/RATIONALE presence, cache hit/miss, TTL expiry, namespace, and FIFO eviction. Verify with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests

Preserve all earlier project files and components. This task depends on the v2 response-cache agreement established in trial-76p.
